projects.title: SIM Pondok Tahfidz
projects.description: Sistem Informasi Manajemen Pondok Tahfidz modern untuk tata kelola santri, kurikulum hafalan Al-Qur’an, pencatatan keuangan syariah, dan pelaporan wali santri secara real-time.

architecture.overview: Modular monolithic architecture with strictly typed service-repository pattern, isolated tenant scopes, and atomic database transactions.
keyDecisions: PostgreSQL with JSONB fields for extensible tahfidz grade rubric.
Laravel Sanctum token authentication with fine-grained role-based permission gates.
Automated Dockerized container workflow for testing and migration pipelines.

keyFeatures: Pelacakan setoran hafalan harian dan rekap musabaqah santri.
Sistem penagihan iuran syahriah otomatis dengan notifikasi.
Dashboard statistik perkembangan santri untuk asatidz dan wali.

projects.title: Katalog Pustaka
projects.description: A book catalog application developed through weekly coursework in Software Construction and Evolution, covering book records, stock, and token-based authentication. The project grows alongside my DevOps practice, with containerized services, automated testing and image publishing, and infrastructure monitoring.

architecture.overview: A Vue 3 SPA communicates with a Laravel 13 REST API through an Nginx reverse proxy. The API uses Sanctum authentication and PostgreSQL, with FrankenPHP serving the backend. Docker Compose defines the application and monitoring services. GitHub Actions runs tests and builds before publishing commit-tagged images to GHCR, while Prometheus and Grafana provide container and host monitoring.
keyDecisions: Separate frontend and API containers behind an Nginx reverse proxy.
Protect book-management endpoints with Sanctum bearer tokens.
Persist PostgreSQL data using a named Docker volume.
Publish commit-tagged container images after backend tests and frontend builds.
Version Grafana dashboards and Prometheus configuration alongside application code.

projects.title: SIA UGN
projects.description: Sistem Informasi Akademik perguruan tinggi berkapasitas konkurensi tinggi untuk rencana studi mahasiswa, penjadwalan ruang kuliah otomatis, dan transkrip nilai terenkripsi.

architecture.overview: High-throughput RESTful API designed with Redis caching layer and optimistic concurrency locks for KRS traffic surges.
keyDecisions: Optimistic locking during course selection to prevent race conditions in capacity caps.
In-memory Redis caching for fast syllabus and timetable lookup.
Aggregation pipelines for rapid transcript GPA calculations.

keyFeatures: Pengisian Kartu Rencana Studi (KRS) real-time dengan validasi prasyarat matakuliah.
Algoritma penjadwalan kelas bebas bentrok dosen dan ruangan.
API gateway terisolasi untuk integrasi data kelembagaan.

projects.title: Bimbel Lazuardy
projects.description: Platform pembelajaran interaktif dan bimbingan belajar berbasis web dengan visualisasi progres siswa, tryout ujian berkala, dan modul interaktif.

architecture.overview: Composition API-driven Single Page Application with centralized Pinia reactive state stores and custom responsive design system tokens.
keyDecisions: Vue 3 Composition API with script setup for maximum type safety and render performance.
Pinia state hydration for persistent student practice session states.
Zero-dependency SVG chart rendering for progress telemetry.

keyFeatures: Simulasi tryout dengan timer otomatis dan anti-kecurangan tab tracking.
Analisis butir soal dan grafik penguasaan materi per siswa.
Antarmuka ramah mobile untuk akses materi belajar di mana saja.

badges.title: Implement CI/CD Pipelines on Google Cloud Skill Badge

image.alt: implement ci cd pipelines on google clou

badges.description: Earn the intermediate skill badge by completing the Implement CI/CD Pipelines on Google Cloud course where you will learn how to use Artifact Registry, Cloud Build, and Cloud Deploy. You will interact with the Cloud console, Google Cloud CLI, Cloud Run, and GKE. This course will teach you how to build continuous integration pipelines, store and secure artifacts, scan for vulnerabilities, attest to the validity of approved releases.
